defects.description: DB_HOST points at `postgres:5432`, but the database service is named `db` (its image is postgres, but there is no service or host `postgres`).
paraphrases: Gitea connects to host `postgres`, which is not a defined service; the DB service is `db`.
DB_HOST should be `db:5432`; `postgres` is the image name, not the service name.
Dangling host reference: no service named `postgres` exists.
defects.rationale: Findable by cross-checking DB_HOST against the service names; the DB service is `db`, not `postgres`.

defects.description: DB_USER is `admin`, but the Postgres role created by the db service is `gitea` (POSTGRES_USER=gitea), so the login role does not exist.
paraphrases: Gitea authenticates as `admin` but the database only creates the `gitea` role.
The database username is inconsistent between the app and the db service.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing DB_USER to POSTGRES_USER in the same file; should be `gitea`.

defects.description: DB_NAME is `giteadb`, but the database created by the db service is `gitea` (POSTGRES_DB=gitea), so Gitea targets a database that does not exist.
paraphrases: Gitea looks for database `giteadb` but the server only creates `gitea`.
The database name is inconsistent between the app and the db service.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing DB_NAME to POSTGRES_DB in the same file; should be `gitea`.
